title: Pomp and toasts: Day 2 of Trump and Xi in DC
summary: Xi’s first visit to Washington in a decade was a display of pomp and pageantry, with Trump offering his guest a two-month truce on the brewing tariff war.

blocks.text: US President Donald Trump held talks with President Xi Jinping at the White House on the second day of the Chinese leader's visit to Washington DC.
There was pomp and ceremony, but little in the way of confirmed progress on key issues.
The day ended with a state dinner, which was attended by major tech CEO's including Tesla's Elon Musk and OpenAI's Sam Altman.
